name: i18n-tooling
description: Shared product UI i18n pipelines and frontend tooling

scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.smoke:cli: node packages/i18n-pipeline/dist/cli.js version && ./packages/i18n-pipeline/dist/cli.js version && node packages/i18n-pipeline/dist/cli.js validate --adapter formatjs-json --catalog packages/i18n-pipeline/tests/fixtures/rbac-ui/translation-template.json --role source --locale en && ./packages/i18n-pipeline/dist/cli.js validate --adapter formatjs-json --catalog packages/i18n-pipeline/tests/fixtures/rbac-ui/translation-template.json --role source --locale en
scripts.i18n:validate: npm run build --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/i18n-pipeline && node packages/i18n-pipeline/dist/cli.js validate
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint:eslint && npm run format:check
